flows.desc: UC-GEND-01 (T-GEND-001/002/003/005): at 1440x900 over astro preview the hero answers the evaluation question WITHOUT scrolling — one-screen identity statement (universal AI chat and agent UI components for React Native, copy-paste registry, NOT an npm package), version counter 0.2.1 and item counters 56/39/11/6 computed at build from package.json + src/data/registry-items.json, and both Get started (/registry) / Browse components (/components) CTAs resolving 200. Geometric fold proof: hero element bounding boxes inside the viewport.

UC-GEND-01 AC-3 / UC-GEND-04 (T-GEND-004): one click on the hero install copy yields exactly the displayed command matching ^npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements\.com/r/(nativewind|uniwind)/[a-z0-9-]+\.json$ with a visible success state within 500 ms; the engine segment follows the persisted engine tab (localStorage 'rnr-engine', documented default nativewind, never in the URL); the full command stays selectable with JavaScript disabled.

UC-GEND-04 AC-1 (T-GEND-013 subset — all 39 existing /components/[item] pages; ui/lib item pages do not exist yet and complete at Sprint 04/05): every component page renders the engine-tabbed install block first; one-click copy on EACH engine tab yields that engine's exact absolute-URL command with a success state; both engines' panel text is server-rendered so the zero-JS project still reads it (T-SHELL-012); no short-name or un-tabbed duplicated forms anywhere (T-GEND-016).

UC-GEND-04 AC-2 (T-GEND-015 subset): shimmer and every chat-family component page render a dependency panel listing dependencies[] and registryDependencies[] VERBATIM from src/data/registry-items.json, with {engine} resolved per engine tab and {version} resolved from package.json at build; the AI SDK v7 peer is named — `ai` with the version range derived at build from apps/example/package.json (site-facts.json), never hand-typed. The >=5-sampled live-/r/*.json diff and dev-client peers/permissions matrix complete at Sprint 04.

UC-SHELL-01 AC-1 (T-SHELL-001): the header theme toggle flips the site theme (dark background oklch(0.145 0 0) vs light oklch(1 0 0)), writes localStorage 'rnr-theme', and the choice persists across reload; the header stays sticky at scrollY 1000 on a scrollable route; no wrong-theme frame on reload — the theme attribute is already correct at domContentLoaded via the pre-paint is:inline script. Theme state never appears in the URL; without JavaScript the toggle hides and the pre-paint-resolved theme remains readable.

UC-SHELL-01 AC-2 (T-SHELL-002): fresh (zero-storage) browser contexts with prefers-color-scheme dark render /docs/theming, /, and /components/message DARK from the FIRST frame — no light flash — via the pre-paint theme script on cold navigation (no bfcache); a light-scheme fresh context renders light. The /docs/theming route is the minimal real page created this sprint to host the content-shaped cold-boot proof. (The no-preference-renders-dark clause defers to sprint-05 — emulating 'no preference' is unreliable in Chromium.)
